args.cmd: sleep 90; pgrep -x micromamba >/dev/null && echo RUNNING || echo DONE; ps -p $(pgrep -x micromamba | head -1) -o pid= -o etime= -o time= -o pcpu= -o stat= 2>/dev/null; echo ---LOG---; tail -2 /tmp/sage_install.log; echo ---CACHE---; sudo du -sh /opt/micromamba-root 2>/dev/null; echo ---PKGS---; sudo du -sh /opt/micromamba-root/pkgs 2>/dev/null; true
